{{Top|leg}}
The '''Humbar''' were an influential political dynasty within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the Humbar in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," a history of the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]] that was published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Nathan O'Keefe]], the author of ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', mentioned the Humbar as a reference to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], and he speculated that the Humbar were the world's original colonists.<ref name="TTSP endnotes">{{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}}</ref>
